providers.name: SpriteCook Free Assets
providers.notes: Machine-readable CC0 catalog. Binary assets are fetched only after an explicit Download action.

providers.name: Kenney
providers.notes: CC0 catalog. The remote metadata index is fetched only after the user explicitly selects Kenney; individual image bytes are fetched only after Download.

providers.name: Universal LPC
providers.notes: LIVE verified subset from the canonical LPC repository. Only items whose direct PNG path and per-item credit/license metadata were verified are exposed as downloadable. This first gate is CC0-only; mixed-license items remain excluded until their individual import contract is verified.

providers.name: OpenGameArt
providers.notes: Discovery-only until an item has a verified direct file URL and compatible license. Client-side bulk scraping is intentionally disabled.
